purpose: Presentation-only update of the validated synthetic board; no numerical solver rerun.
silkscreen: Visible 0.9 mm reference labels with 0.15 mm strokes; U2 reference shifted 1.5 mm left; fabrication values hidden, their stored values unchanged.
comparison: All extracted pre-edit and post-edit properties match exactly after inverse translation, rounding XY to KiCad resolution (0.000001 mm), and excluding the source-file hash. No copper refill was performed.
historical_comparison: Original validation extraction also matches after inverse translation and ignoring file hash, KiCad patch-version metadata, and the dielectric loss tangent. Before this edit, a KiCad save had already changed the saved dielectric loss tangent from 0 to 0.02. That parameter is not consumed by this DC-resistance/steady-thermal model or its explicit lumped AC circuit.
cache_behavior: The existing cache and verify commands use the complete board-file hash. The new presentation file does not match the historical run identity; verify rejects that identity and a new run recomputes its stages. Geometry equivalence is recorded separately and does not bypass those checks.
